doclang.heading: Step 2 - Creating a PFD Definition File
doclang.text: Example Actions: To create a PFD definition file, type 12 (Work with PFD definition files) on the command line on the IBM Advanced Function Printing Utilities for iSeries menu and press the Enter key.
The Work with PFD Definition Files display appears to create a PFD definition file.
The library name that you used last is displayed in the Library prompt and *ALL is displayed in the File prompt.
Example Actions: Type MYLIB in the Library prompt and press the Enter key to list PFD definition files stored in MYLIB.
Note: No PFD definition file is shown because no PFD definition files are stored in MYLIB.
